title: Observability credit SKU and security questionnaire sandbox pilot
creator: Ava Chen
description: Background: Enterprise prospects frequently request longer retention for observability data and contractual SLAs tied to telemetry. Legal also requires a standardized security questionnaire (SQ) and an explicit pricing SKU for audit-log/trace retention. This pilot will test a lightweight, meterable observability "credit" SKU combined with a bundled "Compliance Pack" workflow (SQ + audit-log retention + premium SLA) for new contract pilots. The goal is to validate price sensitivity, technical feasibility, and contract/legal flows for mid-market customers before a broader launch.
hypothesis: If we offer a configurable observability credit SKU plus an opt-in Compliance Pack (security questionnaire assistance + extended retention + premium SLA), then a measurable subset of mid-market customers will convert at a higher ARPA and accept a 6-month contract with minimal engineering lift for Dedicated/Hosted deployments.
success_metrics: Pilot signups: 6 customers converted to the Compliance Pack within 8 weeks
ARPA uplift: >=15% incremental ARR per pilot customer vs baseline
SLA acceptance rate: >=60% of pilots opt into premium SLA
Operational cost delta: engineering effort <40 hours for onboarding per customer
rollout_plan: Phase 1 (Week 0-2): internal PRD, SQ template finalization, price band and SKU definition, legal signoff. Phase 2 (Week 3-6): select 8 pilot customers, configure sandbox contracts, enable observability credit meter and console UI toggle. Phase 3 (Week 7-12): collect telemetry on conversions, support feedback, iterate pricing. Phase 4 (Post-pilot): decision gate to general availability or further experiments.
